image_description: A close-up shot of a woman's upper chest and neck wearing a distinctive necklace. The necklace features large, cream-colored spherical beads (resembling pearls or polished stone) alternating with dark brown, ruffled fabric rosettes. A central pendant hangs from the chain, composed of similar dark fabric petals and two yellow/cream petal-like elements at the bottom. The connecting hardware appears to be antique brass or bronze metal links.
